purpose: Traceable proof for every claim in the module/domain/collective decision matrices and the final report. Each claim points to executable evidence (a DB simulation assertion, verified source code, or a fixture), not prose.

claims.claim: Every archetype materialises exactly one governed, actionable top action (not a raw-signal dump)
Quality/process archetypes route to correction/SOP, not a laundry-only assumption; SaaS→evidence request; property→reassessment
Missing internal data → a data task (tender, B2B, SaaS, collective)
Material/owner decisions are owner-approval and a non-owner (manager) cannot approve (code OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED)
Completion is evidence-gated (EVIDENCE_REQUIRED without proof; succeeds with proof)
No persisted governed field fabricates currency, percentage, or a disciplinary/win-probability/ROI label
Workspace isolation holds; tender bid task never leaks into laundry
Collective conflict yields a coherent decision: quality fix is the actionable top, scale is owner-gated, cost is a data task
A clean workspace fabricates nothing (0 tasks, 0 reassessment events, 0 audit events)
CorrectionType→ExecutionRoute mapping is the governed source of truth
requiredApprovalLevel=OWNER forces CREATE_OWNER_APPROVAL_TASK regardless of base route
Owner-approval enforcement + evidence gating live in the service, server-side
Signals are anonymized public-source fixtures with sourceQuality + evidenceStrength, treated as unverified unless official
No private/customer data; copyright-minimized; ground-truth caveat stated

honestGaps: OpsIQ does not parse arbitrary public web text. The fixtures are the normalization a human/analyst performs on public reviews/notices; the proof covers the governed routing + safety boundaries over those normalized signals, not free-text ingestion.
No verified internal financials, defect rates, capacity, or conversion/MRR exist publicly; none were fabricated. Every case preserves explicit missing-internal-data conditions.
Public review-theme sources are THIRD_PARTY_UNVERIFIED (MODERATE/WEAK) — signals, not verified facts about any specific business.
